records.context: Torch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost wheels can load independent LLVM OpenMP runtimes into one process. Crossing their background execution unit state can terminate the process, particularly when ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suppresses the runtime's duplicate-initialization guard.

records.source: Torch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost wheels can load independent LLVM OpenMP runtimes into one process. Crossing their worker-thread state can terminate the process, particularly when ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suppresses the runtime's duplicate-initialization guard.
records.translation: Torch, scikit-learn और XGBoost wheels एक ही प्रक्रिया में स्वतंत्र LLVM OpenMP runtimes लोड कर सकते हैं। उनकी worker-thread अवस्था के आपस में टकराने से प्रक्रिया समाप्त हो सकती है, विशेष रूप से जब ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` runtime के duplicate-initialization guard को दबा देता है।

records.context: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting independent execution path. This serializes that independent execution path's parallel regions without imposing a process-wide ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` limit on segmentation and other workloads. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#2
records.source: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting thread. This serializes that thread's parallel regions without imposing a process-wide ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` limit on segmentation and other workloads. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.translation: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` mapped runtimes का पता लगाता है और, जब एक से अधिक मौजूद हों, fitting thread पर ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` कॉल करता है। यह segmentation और अन्य workloads पर प्रक्रिया-व्यापी ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` सीमा लगाए बिना उस thread के parallel regions को क्रमबद्ध करता है। estimator के ``n_jobs`` और ``nthread`` तर्क विकल्प नहीं हैं क्योंकि वे OpenMP runtime को worker team बनाने से नहीं रोकते।

records.translation: प्रकाशित TSG101 स्क्रीनिंग, अलग-अलग download किए जा सकने वाले भागों के रूप में।

records.context: The screening experiment is four plates of about 8 GB of extracted image regions each plus a half-gigabyte database each -- 33 GB in total. The regression, measurement and cell functions read only the databases; the extracted image regions are needed only to display images. A single archive would require a 33 GB download to try one function.
records.label: spacr.screen_data#1
records.source: The screen is four plates of about 8 GB of crops each plus a half-gigabyte database each -- 33 GB in total. The regression, measurement and cell functions read only the databases; the crops are needed only to display images. A single archive would require a 33 GB download to try one function.
records.translation: यह स्क्रीनिंग चार प्लेटों की है, हर एक में लगभग 8 GB crops और साथ में आधा-गीगाबाइट database -- कुल 33 GB। regression, measurement और cell फ़ंक्शन केवल databases पढ़ते हैं; crops केवल छवियाँ दिखाने के लिए आवश्यक हैं। एक ही archive होने पर एक फ़ंक्शन आज़माने के लिए 33 GB download करना पड़ता।

records.context: So each plate's database and each plate's extracted-image-region folder is its own archive, and :class:`ScreenAsset` says how big each one is BEFORE it is fetched. The picker in the Regression screening experiment lists them with their sizes and downloads only what is selected.
records.label: spacr.screen_data#2
records.source: So each plate's database and each plate's crop folder is its own archive, and :class:`ScreenAsset` says how big each one is BEFORE it is fetched. The picker in the Regression screen lists them with their sizes and downloads only what is selected.
records.translation: इसलिए हर प्लेट का database और हर प्लेट का crop फ़ोल्डर अपना अलग archive है, और :class:`ScreenAsset` बताता है कि हर एक कितना बड़ा है, उसे fetch किए जाने से पहले (BEFORE)। Regression screen का picker उन्हें उनके आकार के साथ सूचीबद्ध करता है और केवल वही download करता है जो चुना गया है।

records.context: The `merged/` folders are deliberately absent. They are about 300 GB per plate -- 1.2 TB for the screening experiment -- which is past what a public dataset host will take without arrangement, and nothing in Regression reads them.
records.label: spacr.screen_data#3
records.source: The `merged/` folders are deliberately absent. They are about 300 GB per plate -- 1.2 TB for the screen -- which is past what a public dataset host will take without arrangement, and nothing in Regression reads them.
records.translation: `merged/` फ़ोल्डर जानबूझकर अनुपस्थित हैं। वे प्रति प्लेट लगभग 300 GB हैं -- पूरी स्क्रीनिंग के लिए 1.2 TB -- जो किसी सार्वजनिक dataset host की बिना व्यवस्था के स्वीकार्य सीमा से अधिक है, और Regression में कुछ भी उन्हें नहीं पढ़ता।
